Class NeonSocket

java.lang.Object
com.quietterminal.neon.core.NeonSocket
All Implemented Interfaces:
Transport, AutoCloseable
public final class NeonSocket extends Object implements Transport, AutoCloseable
UDP socket wrapper built on a non-blocking NIO DatagramChannel.

Always backed by a non-blocking channel; blocking semantics are emulated via a Selector with a configurable timeout so that virtual threads are never pinned to a carrier thread during network waits.

When DTLS is active, encryption and decryption are transparent: send(byte[], SocketAddress) encrypts outbound data for known peers and receive() decrypts inbound DTLS records. Call performClientHandshake(SSLContext, SocketAddress, int) on host/client sockets before sending any Neon packets. Call enableServerDtls(SSLContext) on relay sockets to accept inbound DTLS connections.

  • Method Details

    • performClientHandshake

      public void performClientHandshake(SSLContext ctx, SocketAddress peer, int timeoutMs) throws IOException
      Performs the DTLS client-side handshake with peer. Must be called before sending any Neon packets when DTLS is enabled. Blocks until the handshake completes or times out.
      Parameters:
      ctx - DTLS SSLContext initialised with a TrustManager (or KeyManager for mutual auth)
      peer - the relay address to handshake with
      timeoutMs - maximum time to wait for the handshake to complete
      Throws:
      IOException - if the handshake fails or times out

    • enableServerDtls

      public void enableServerDtls(SSLContext ctx)
      Enables server-side DTLS on this socket. The relay calls this so that inbound DTLS ClientHello records automatically trigger handshakes for new peers.
      Parameters:
      ctx - DTLS SSLContext initialised with a KeyManager (relay certificate + key)

    • removeDtlsSession

      public void removeDtlsSession(SocketAddress address)
      Removes the DTLS session for address. Call when a peer disconnects.
